tools.name: check_market
tools.description: Check current trading prices for an item on warframe.market. Returns median price, price range, recent volume, top sell offers from online players, and 90-day price trend. Use this when a user asks about item value, whether to buy or sell, or trading prices.

item.description: Item name to check price for (e.g. 'Ash Prime Set', 'Condition Overload', 'Primed Continuity')

tools.name: compare_weapons
tools.description: Compare 2-4 weapons side by side showing all stats. Optionally includes optimal build DPS calculations. Use when a user is choosing between weapons or asks which weapon is better.

weapons.description: List of 2-4 weapon names to compare (e.g. ['Soma Prime', 'Braton Prime', 'Boltor Prime'])

include_build.description: Also calculate DPS with optimal builds for each weapon (default: false)

tools.name: farm_guide
tools.description: Get a comprehensive farming guide for any Warframe item. Shows all drop sources ranked by efficiency, drop rates, recommended farming frames/strategies, and a buy-vs-farm comparison using warframe.market prices. Use when a user asks how to get or farm something.

item.description: Item to farm (e.g. 'Ash Prime', 'Condition Overload', 'Argon Crystal', 'Neural Sensors')

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Search for any Warframe item by name. Returns basic info including category, description, mastery requirement, and components. For detailed weapon/warframe/mod stats, use the specific tools instead.

query.description: Item name to search for (weapon, warframe, mod, resource, etc.)

tools.name: get_mod
tools.description: Get detailed information about a Warframe mod including stats at each rank, drain, polarity, rarity, compatible equipment type, and what it does. Use this to check exact mod values for build calculations.

name.description: Mod name to search for (e.g. 'Serration', 'Split Chamber', 'Vital Sense')

tools.name: get_warframe
tools.description: Get detailed stats for a Warframe including health, shields, armor, energy, sprint speed, abilities with descriptions, passive, aura polarity, and mod polarities. Use this to understand a frame's capabilities for build planning.

name.description: Warframe name to look up (e.g. 'Mesa Prime', 'Saryn', 'Wisp')

tools.name: get_weapon
tools.description: Get detailed stats for a Warframe weapon including damage breakdown, critical chance, critical multiplier, status chance, fire rate, magazine size, reload time, multishot, riven disposition, and polarities. Use this to analyze weapons for build planning.

name.description: Weapon name to look up (e.g. 'Braton Prime', 'Soma Prime', 'Rubico Prime')

tools.name: recommend_build
tools.description: Calculate the optimal mod build for a weapon based on the goal. Uses Warframe's actual damage formulas to compute real DPS numbers. Returns the recommended mod list, DPS breakdown, and explanation of why each mod was chosen. This is NOT a guess - it's mathematically calculated.

goal.description: Build goal. Default 'general_dps' auto-detects best approach. 'viral_slash' for Viral+Slash proc meta. 'corrosive' for anti-armor. 'comfort' includes QoL mods.

enemy_type.description: Enemy to calculate effective DPS against (e.g. 'Corrupted Heavy Gunner', 'Corpus Tech')

enemy_level.description: Enemy level for scaling calculations (e.g. 100, 175 for Steel Path)

tools.name: search_builds
tools.description: Search Overframe.gg for community-created builds for any Warframe, weapon, or companion. Returns builds sorted by community votes (score). Supports filtering by keywords in build titles (e.g. 'steel path', 'endgame', 'beginner'). Use this to find popular, community-validated builds rather than mathematically calculated ones.

item.description: Warframe or weapon name to search builds for (e.g. 'Kullervo', 'Soma Prime', 'Nikana Prime')

filter.description: Filter builds by keywords in title (e.g. 'steel path', 'endgame', 'beginner', 'low forma'). Multiple keywords can be comma-separated and ANY match will be included.

tools.name: search_community
tools.description: Search r/Warframe Reddit for community discussions, build guides, farming strategies, tier lists, and player opinions. Returns post titles, scores, and snippets. Use this to find community consensus on builds, meta, or game strategies.

query.description: Search query (e.g. 'best Mesa Prime build 2025', 'how to farm Wisp', 'Steel Path tier list')

tools.name: search_drops
tools.description: Find where an item drops in Warframe — which enemies, missions, relics, or activities drop it and at what rates. Use this when a user asks how to get/farm a specific item.

query.description: Item name to find drop sources for (e.g. 'Ash Prime Neuroptics', 'Condition Overload', 'Argon Crystal')

tools.name: search_wiki
tools.description: Search the Warframe Wiki for articles about any Warframe topic — weapons, warframes, mechanics, lore, quests, resources, enemies, etc. Returns article titles and summaries. Use this when you need detailed game information beyond basic stats.

query.description: Search query for the Warframe Wiki

tools.name: world_state
tools.description: Get the current live game state in Warframe — active Void Fissures, Sortie missions, Invasions, Baro Ki'Teer status, Nightwave challenges, day/night cycles (Cetus, Vallis, Cambion), Archon Hunt, Steel Path honors, and active events. Use this when a user asks what's happening in the game right now.

category.description: What game state info to get (default: all — returns summary of everything)
